shock_by_2028.anchor: Manifold ACX 'visible break in US macro trend attributed to AI by 2028' 30% (643 traders), but that also counts positive GDP or productivity breaks, so the unemployment part is well below it.

shock_by_2030.anchor: Manifold 'AI causes US unemployment > 10% before 2030' 23% (175 traders; needs >= 3 pp attributable to AI), discounted for Manifold's pro-AI skew.

shock_by_2035.anchor: Manifold AGI series (RemNi): 58% before 2032, 63% before 2035; times P(shock | AGI) about 0.5-0.6.

shock_by_2040.anchor: Manifold 'AGI before 2040' 72% (98 traders) times P(shock | AGI) about 0.6.

shock_by_2050.anchor: Manifold 'AGI before 2048' 87%; '>97% of jobs automated before 2075' 63%.

politics_lag_years.note: Years between shock onset and it driving legislation (rounded).
politics_lag_years.anchor: JUDGMENT; the 2020 CARES Act passed within weeks, but a permanent program needs a sustained shock.

p_R_trifecta_2027.note: R trifecta in 2027-28 (a D trifecta is impossible with an R president).
p_R_trifecta_2027.anchor: Polymarket 2026: House D 92.5%, Senate D 62.5% (fetched 2026-09-29); correlated.

p_D_trifecta_2029.anchor: Polymarket 2028 presidency D 64.5% x P(House and Senate | D president) about 0.5.

p_R_trifecta_2029.anchor: Polymarket 2028 presidency R 34.5% x P(House and Senate | R president) about 0.45-0.5.

p_D_trifecta_later.note: D trifecta after each presidential election from 2032 on.
p_D_trifecta_later.anchor: Recent base rate: a trifecta started 6 of the 7 presidential terms from 2001 to 2025 (D twice, R four times).

p_R_trifecta_later.note: R trifecta after each presidential election from 2032 on.
p_R_trifecta_later.anchor: Same base rate as the D input.

p_keep_trifecta_midterm.anchor: Of the six trifectas that started a presidential term from 1993 to 2021, only the 2001 one survived its midterm (2002); 1994, 2006, 2010, 2018 and 2022 each flipped a chamber.

e_D_normal.anchor: DATA: no strict-UBI endorsement by any of the ten governments in about 75 terms since 2000.

e_div_normal.note: The President endorses under divided government, no shock.

e_D_shock.note: D trifecta endorses during a shock.
e_D_shock.anchor: JUDGMENT: no trigger-type shock in the record.

e_R_shock.note: R trifecta endorses during a shock.

e_div_shock.note: The President endorses under divided government during a shock.

pass_D.note: An endorsed UBI passes under a D trifecta.
pass_D.anchor: DATA: about half of US trifectas' flagship priorities since 1993 passed.

pass_R.note: An endorsed UBI passes under an R trifecta.

pass_div.note: An endorsed UBI passes under divided government.

amount_median_normal.note: Median amount if enacted without a shock.
amount_median_normal.anchor: JUDGMENT; dividend-scale programs (the Alaska PFD is about $1,000).

amount_median_shock.note: Median amount if enacted during a shock.
amount_median_shock.anchor: JUDGMENT; Yang's Freedom Dividend was $12,000 (2020 dollars).

ratchet_per_year.note: Yearly chance a trifecta raises an existing program during a shock.

q_floor_D_normal.note: Means-tested floor >= $6k for childless adults, D, normal.

q_ctc_D.note: A D trifecta Congress enacts it.
q_ctc_D.anchor: JUDGMENT; ARPA did it for TY2021, and extending it failed in 2021-22 with 50 Senate seats.

q_ctc_R.note: An R trifecta Congress enacts it.
q_ctc_R.anchor: JUDGMENT; the 2025 law kept the earnings phase-in.

q_ctc_div.anchor: JUDGMENT; the 2024 Wyden-Smith deal used a lookback, which wouldn't count.

p_ctc_same_tax_year.note: Share of enactments that apply to the enactment year (as ARPA did).

p_2028_primary_winner_backs_ubi.note: Some 2028 D or R primary or caucus winner backed a UBI since 2025.
p_2028_primary_winner_backs_ubi.anchor: JUDGMENT; Yang has floated a 2028 run (unverified), and most frontrunners haven't endorsed a UBI.
